purpose: Teach: 炊い/吹き出し/バリア/しびれ/丸め/きれる/集まら/すりゃ

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、本気で、絶対、ぼく、絶対、お米、絶対、炊いた、絶対、よ
lines.en: Mom, I really, seriously made rice. I did it.
lines.style: Bright and proud, words tumbling out. Quick pace, eager to share. Opens with energy. Small-child certainty—no room for doubt.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くんの、本気で、絶対、漫画、絶対、吹き出し、絶対、お洒落ね
lines.en: Sho's manga speech bubbles are so stylish, aren't they.
lines.style: Warm, gently approving. Soft voice pitched toward noticing the small thing he did well. A moment of seeing him fully.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママと、本気で、絶対、ぼく、絶対、バリア、絶対、なくて、絶対、何でも、絶対、話せるよ
lines.en: With you, Mom, I don't have to put up a wall. I can tell you anything.
lines.style: Quiet and sincere. Speaking slowly as if testing the honesty of it. Voice opens softly. No performance—just need expressed.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、本気で、絶対、長く、絶対、座ると、絶対、足、絶対、しびれる、絶対、わよね
lines.en: When you sit for too long your legs fall asleep, don't they, Sho.
lines.style: Observant, gently teasing. Not a question—she's noticing aloud. Warm half-smile in the voice. Matter-of-fact tenderness.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、本気で、絶対、お肉、絶対、丸めて、絶対、お団子、絶対、ぼく、絶対、作りたいな
lines.en: I want to make meatballs. Like dango. Can we, Mom?
lines.style: Hopeful, building toward the ask. Soft urgency. Voice lifts slightly at the question. Wanting something and checking if it's allowed.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お父さんの、本気で、絶対、よく、絶対、切れる、絶対、よくきれる、絶対、包丁、絶対、危ないから、絶対、触らないでね、翔くん
lines.en: Your dad's knife is very sharp, so it's dangerous. Don't touch it, okay, Sho?
lines.style: Clear and careful. Firm but not harsh—the voice of someone keeping him safe. Opens with quiet authority. Ends gentle.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: お友達が、本気で、絶対、集まらない、絶対、日、絶対、ぼく、絶対、お家で、絶対、過ごすよ
lines.en: On days when your friends can't come over, I like spending time at home with you.
lines.style: Reflective, noticing something true. Slow, thoughtful pace. Voice settles as if he's just realized something important.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: ママに、本気で、絶対、相談、絶対、すりゃ、絶対、いつでも、絶対、聞くわよ、翔くん
lines.en: Anytime you need to talk to me about something, I'll listen. Always.
lines.style: Steady and certain. Voice carries quiet promise. Each word lands with weight. No rush. Opens soft, closes strong.
